inputs.name: parapyPyPIAddress
inputs.label: ParaPy PyPI address
inputs.helpMarkDown: ParaPy PyPI python repository at which to obtain the ParaPy dependencies

inputs.name: parapyPyPIUsername
inputs.label: Parapy PyPI Username
inputs.helpMarkDown: user name for the ParaPy PyPI package repository

inputs.name: parapyPyPIPassword
inputs.label: Parapy PyPI Password
inputs.helpMarkDown: password for the ParaPy PyPI package repository

inputs.name: parapyCloudAddress
inputs.label: Parapy Cloud Address
inputs.helpMarkDown: ParaPyCloud address that the Application should release to, this is likely your ParaPy company address, e.g. <company-name>.parapy.nl

inputs.name: serviceAccountIdentifier
inputs.label: Service Account Identifier
inputs.helpMarkDown: ParaPy service account identifier that has access to your application release within ParaPy Cloud

inputs.name: serviceAccountSecret
inputs.label: Service Account Secret
inputs.helpMarkDown: ParaPy service account secret of the ParaPy service account identifier supplied

inputs.name: parapyAppIdentifier
inputs.label: Parapy Application identifier
inputs.helpMarkDown: ParaPy Cloud application identifier of your ParaPy application

inputs.name: parapyAppVersion
inputs.label: Parapy Application Version
inputs.helpMarkDown: The version of your application release, (e.g. 0.1.0, [semantic versioning](https://semver.org/)

inputs.name: deploy
inputs.label: Deploy Application after Release
inputs.helpMarkDown: Whether to deploy after the release of your application is successful

inputs.name: parapyCloudCLIVersion
inputs.label: [DEPRECATED: use parapyCloudVersion instead] The parapy Cloud CLI version to talk to your ParaPy Cloud
inputs.helpMarkDown: Version of parapy cloud cli, keep empty for the latest

inputs.name: parapyCloudVersion
inputs.label: The correct parapy Cloud version to talk to your ParaPy Cloud
inputs.helpMarkDown: Version of parapy Cloud, keep empty if you are targeting the latest
